description: Generate a disposable email inbox for testing signups, OTP verification, magic links, and password resets. Instant and local — no network request. Use the returned address wherever an email is required, then call wait_for_email to read what arrives. Free tier: 30-minute retention, no signup needed. With a key from zerodrop.dev/keys in ZERODROP_API_KEY, the name starts with the key's prefix and only that key can read the inbox. Anyone can send mail to the address, so say what you expect: with expect_from and expect_link_host, mail from anyone else isn't shown.

expect_from.description: The domain (myapp.com, which covers mail.myapp.com) or address your app sends from. Other senders' mail isn't shown

expect_link_host.description: The host your app's links point to, with the port if it matters (localhost:3000). Mail whose link points elsewhere isn't shown

prefix.description: Optional prefix for the inbox name, e.g. your app or test name

name: generate_inbox
title: Generate inbox
